name: FAR.AI
summary: A nonprofit founded in 2022 and led by Adam Gleave that works to make advanced AI safe: technical research on adversarial robustness, jailbreaks, red-teaming and interpretability; FAR.Labs, a research hub and coworking space in Berkeley; the Alignment Workshops and, through the Safe AI Forum it incubated, the International Dialogues on AI Safety between scientists from China and the West; and a research grant programme funded by Open Philanthropy.
